name: Nessa Ilt
description: The Coldwater Holding's engineer, who built the jury-rig, has worked out what it is doing, and has not said so in a meeting.
narrative:
She built it in nine days out of parts that were never meant to go near a
coupling collar, and it worked, and the stuttering stopped for five months and
everybody thanked her.

She has since worked out that it did not stop the fault. It hid it -- and the
eight months it hid are eight months nobody spent fixing anything.

She has drafted the thing she needs to say to the council four times.
equipment: Four drafts of the same statement
actor_notes: The fastest route to the truth in entry point A, and she will take it if anybody asks her a technical question in good faith. She is not hiding -- she is ashamed, which looks identical from outside. If the player gives her the chance to be the one who says it, take it: that is a better ending for her than being found out.
